erp.readFailed: This file could not be read.
erp.intro: Upload the ERP Stores Ledger export (report CSOL-IMS-013-1), one file per store, exactly as the ERP saves it. Nothing is saved until you post a file. Rates are kept with the upload and are not used as stock cost.
erp.ownerOnly: Only the owner can post an ERP stores ledger. You can see earlier uploads below.
erp.loadingRef: Loading the Material Master and store locations for {country}...
erp.refTruncated: The Material Master for {country} is larger than this screen reads at once; some codes may show as new.
erp.filesSub: Open a file to check every change before you post it. * = the ERP spells the store differently.
erp.duplicates: Some files have the same content as another file in this list ({list}). Only the first of each can be posted.
erp.historyEmpty: No ERP stores ledger has been posted yet.
erp.sumChanges: {n} quantities set to the ERP figure ({up} / {down})
erp.sumNew: {n} new item codes added to the Material Master
erp.sumRenames: {n} item names changed to the ERP wording
erp.sumMissingZero: {n} items not in the file set to zero
erp.sumMissingKeep: {n} items not in the file left as they are
erp.movesAfter: {n} stock movements were recorded at this store on or after {to}. Posting sets the ERP figures and replaces their effect. I understand.
erp.movesUnknown: Tyre Pulse could not check for stock movements at this store since {to}. Posting sets the ERP figures. I understand.
erp.confirmNote: Each change is logged with this file. Added units take the store's current average cost when it has one, otherwise they stay unvalued; ERP rates are not used. Large stores post in parts; if it stops, open the file again and continue.
erp.cancelBody: {file}: no stock has been posted from it yet. The new item codes, names and categories it saved stay.
erp.stockReadFailed: The stock at this store could not be read: {error}
erp.notLedgerBody: This file is not an ERP Stores Ledger (report CSOL-IMS-013-1). Export the Stores Ledger from the ERP and upload that file.
erp.alreadyPostedBody: This exact file was already posted on {at}. It cannot be posted again.
erp.stoppedBody: It started on {at}. Continue it to post the rest; every part is safe to run again.
erp.cancelKeeps: Cancelling keeps the new item codes, names and categories already saved; only unposted stock is dropped.
erp.noLocationBody: No Tyre Pulse warehouse location has the code {stores}. Add the location, or ask for the spelling to be linked, then upload again.
erp.postedBody: Posted: {changed} quantities changed, {zero} set to zero, {added} items added, {names} names updated, {cats} categories set, {held} held back{detail}.
erp.emptyStock: Every quantity already matches the ERP.
erp.emptyNew: Every code is already in the Material Master.
erp.emptyNames: Every name already matches the ERP wording.
erp.emptyCats: No item in this file is unclassified.
erp.zeroMissing: Set these to zero when posting (the ERP shows no stock for them at this store)
erp.emptyMissing: Tyre Pulse holds nothing here that the file leaves out.
erp.keptReserved: Kept: reserved for a job card
erp.stockTruncated: This store has more stock lines than the screen reads at once; the server still uses every line.

picking.noWorkOrder: No job card with this number was found in Work Orders; the list shows stock reserved under this number.

picking.viewOnly: You can view and print this list. Confirming a pick needs the inventory issue permission.

putaway.title: Put-away
putaway.permissionBody: Putting stock away needs the inventory transfer permission. Ask an administrator.
putaway.refused: Not enough free stock on this line. Refresh and try a smaller quantity.
putaway.halfDone: The stock left the receiving area{ref} but was not yet received into the bin: {error} Press "Finish put-away" to try again.

reconcile.intro: Read only. These checks compare each stock line with its own movement ledger. Nothing is corrected from here; a correction is posted through a stock movement or an approved adjustment so the ledger stays the record.
reconcile.truncBody: The scope holds more lines than this screen reads at once. Narrow the country or site to check the rest.
reconcile.skipped: The catalogue links could not be read, so this check was not run.

ledger_drift.label: Ledger differs from balance
ledger_drift.help: The sum of posted movements is not equal to the quantity on hand.

stock_qty_diff.label: Old stock quantity differs
stock_qty_diff.help: The legacy stock quantity column is not equal to the quantity on hand.

qty_no_ledger.label: Quantity with no movements
qty_no_ledger.help: The line holds quantity but no movement was ever posted for it.

reserved_mismatch.label: Reserved quantity differs
reserved_mismatch.help: Reserved quantity is not equal to the sum of reservation movements, or exceeds the quantity on hand.

negative.label: Negative stock
negative.help: Quantity on hand is below zero.

unvalued.label: Quantity without a value
unvalued.help: Part or all of the quantity on hand carries no cost.

unlinked.label: Not linked to Material Master
unlinked.help: The line has no Material Master item.

not_in_catalogue.label: Item not in the governed catalogue
not_in_catalogue.help: The Material Master item has no catalogue link.

repair.truncated: Only part of the stock was read. Choose a site to see all of it.
repair.missingTitle: Some repair locations are not set up
repair.missingBody: A part is tracked as out for repair when it sits in a location of that type. Missing for this scope: {list}. Add them under Locations; a vendor-custody location per repair vendor lets you see what each vendor holds.
repair.title: Parts out of normal use
repair.subValue: Known value {value}. Unvalued quantity {qty} (cost unknown, not zero).
repair.subNoValue: Unvalued quantity {qty}. Values need the view-value permission.
repair.empty: No parts are out for repair, held, damaged or marked scrap.
repair.howSub: Each step is an existing stock movement, so the ledger keeps the history.
repair.step1: Removed part comes in: receive it with condition Damaged or Quarantine (Receiving).
repair.step2: Out to the vendor: transfer it to that vendor's custody location (Movements).
repair.step3: Back from the vendor: receive the transfer into a normal bin.
repair.step4: Cannot be repaired: propose scrap with a reason; it posts only after approval (Warranty and scrap).

state.at_vendor: At vendor (out for repair or exchange)
state.scrap_pending: Marked scrap, not yet written off

tools.notTrackedTitle: Holder and due date are not recorded yet
tools.notTrackedBody: The Tool & Equipment Registry records what each tool is and whether it is in use, but not who has it or when it is due back. The custody log that adds this (with issue, return and calibration records) is written as migration 20261124133000 and is not applied yet. Until it is, a tool marked in use shows its holder as Not recorded, and no tool is called overdue.
tools.noToolsBefore: Register tools and returnable equipment in the
tools.outSub: Overdue first, then longest out. A row without a due date is never called overdue.
tools.outEmpty: Nothing is out with a holder.
tools.availSub: Tools in the registry that are free. A tool with overdue calibration is refused by the server.
tools.availEmpty: No tool is free to issue.
tools.calSub: Overdue first, then due within 30 days. A tool with no calibration date is "Not set", never overdue.
tools.calEmpty: No tool is overdue or due for calibration in the next 30 days.
tools.calHint: To record a calibration for a tool not listed here, use the registry list below.
tools.inUseEmpty: No tool is marked in use.
tools.allSub: Record a calibration for any registered tool.
tools.heldSub: Material issues to a named person, less returns. The issue ledger has no due date, so nothing here is called overdue.
tools.heldTruncated: Only the newest issues were read. Narrow the site to see all of them.
tools.heldEmpty: No stock is recorded as issued to a named person.

warranty.flaggedSub: The usual candidates for a warranty claim or scrap.
warranty.flaggedEmpty: No stock is damaged, quarantined, repairable or marked scrap.
warranty.claimsSub: Approve, reject or record the credit on the Warranty page.

warranty.scrapSub: Scrap reduces stock, so it always needs a reason and a second person's approval.
